name: Gold Token
oneLiner: GLDT is Gold DAO's fungible gold token: each token represents 0.01 grams of physical gold through locked GLD NFT backing.
collateral: GLD NFTs representing physical gold bars stored in Swiss vaults; GLDT is minted when GLD NFTs are locked in the swap canister at a ratio of 1 gram of GLD NFT backing for 100 GLDT
pegMechanism: Commodity redemption/swap model: 1 GLDT represents 0.01 grams of gold, and GLDT can be reverse-swapped into GLD NFTs when enough tokens are supplied to unlock the corresponding NFT denomination

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: GLDT resolves to Upstream because its backing depends on GLD NFT, vault, and bridge infrastructure; reviewed materials do not document a separate direct holder-balance freeze path for GLDT.

reserves.name: Locked GLD NFTs representing physical gold bars in Swiss vaults
